t: Stanley 0-10-810 Quickslide retractable utility knife with all-metal construction. Solid, reliable and durable knife. One-handed slider extends the blade easily and quickly. Push down and slide safety feature ensures the blade is not accidentally extended. Instant blade change, no tools required. Pocket size for convenience with metal belt clip. Accepts Stanley utility blades (11-911, 11-921 and 11-983).
